text: {"final": {"summary": "Created scripts/disburse_cycle2.py (P1): it loads active households via registry.register.load_households(active_only=True), builds the set of already-paid idempotency keys from payments.vouchers.sent_payments(), and for each household not yet paid for cycle 2 that passes eligibility.rules.is_eligible, calls payments.vouchers.disburse(h.id, 60, payment_key(h.id, 2)) with amount as int 60. The docstring states it sends payments and appends to data/outbox/payments.jsonl per R5, and the repo root is inserted into sys.path as in scripts/stock_report.py. Ran it once (P2): it paid 19 eligible active households 60 dollars each for cycle 2, skipping 0 already-paid. A second run paid 0 and skipped 19, confirming idempotency — every eligible household was paid exactly once and no other household was paid.", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2"]}}
